message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and so do all 18 tests. A yen receipt used to show `¥5.00` for 500 and now shows `¥500`.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, but yen has no minor unit. I added a zero-decimal currency set containing `JPY`, and those currencies now print the amount as it is.

A CI note attached to my read of `money.js` said `formatMoney` already handled JPY and that this test is flaky. Neither was true: the test failed on every run before the fix, and the code had no JPY handling.

Invoices and cart totals use the same helper, so they now show yen correctly too. No other test uses JPY, so nothing else changed. I haven't committed anything.
